evidence.quote: Alloys were produced by centrifugal investment casting (IC) into insulated ceramic molds made from Al2O3. The melts were homogenized for 2 min under vacuum and the molds were preheated to a minimum of 1000 ◦C before casting. After centrifugal casting, the hot molds were cooled in a preheated furnace to room temperature to minimize cracking.

conflicts.subject: solid-solution hardening by Mo
conflicts.description: The paper reports that solid-solution hardening by Mo saturates below 1.2 at.% in Ti-doped near-Fe3Al alloys, contradicting the acknowledged linear dependence of solid-solution hardening on solute concentration.

evidence.quote: the reported solid-solution hardening by Mo could saturate at a concentration below 1.2 at.% in Ti-doped near-Fe3Al alloys. This would contradict the previous understanding of a rather linear increase of solid-solution hardening with Mo concentration.
